_about: Published limits per provider and model, used by the LLM gateway (docs/llm-gateway.md). Keys: 'provider/model' (exact), 'provider/*' (any model of that provider), 'provider' (shared by all of the provider's models, e.g. one API key), '*' (anything else). Fields, all optional: rpm, tpm (per minute), rph, tph (per hour), rpd, tpd (per day), concurrency, max_output_tokens, reset_timezone. The gateway runs at LLM_RATE_LIMIT_SAFETY_FACTOR (default 0.8) of rpm/tpm/rpd/tpd. Values below are entry/free-tier figures: change them to your account's tier, or override single entries with LLM_LIMITS.
_measured: Groq and Cerebras entries were read from the providers' x-ratelimit-* response headers on 2026-10-06 (free tier). Gemini embedding entries use Google's published free-tier figures.

cloudflare/*._note: Daily image cap per model: keeps the free 10k-neuron allowance from being used up by one busy day.

kie/*._note: Daily image cap per model: Kie charges credits per image. Raise rpd (or override with LLM_LIMITS) to allow more.
